question: Select the personality who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi 2021 award for his/her contribution in Kuchipudi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**N Sailaja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **N Sailaja** is a renowned Kuchipudi dancer known for her exceptional contributions to this classical dance form.

• She was awarded the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2021** for her significant impact on and dedication to Kuchipudi.

• Kuchipudi is a traditional Indian dance form that originates from the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.

• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is one of the highest national recognitions given to practicing artists in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Kuchipudi:**

• Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dances, with its roots in the ancient Hindu Sanskrit text of Natya Shastra.

• The dance is typically a dance-drama performance, with its themes often centered around Hindu religious stories and epics.

• It combines fast rhythms, elaborate footwork, expressive gestures (mudras), and dramatic storytelling.

• Originally performed by male dancers, today Kuchipudi is performed by both men and women, and it has gained immense popularity worldwide.

• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**

• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is the highest recognition given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.

• It is awarded annually to artists in the field of performing arts, including music, dance, and theater.

• The award consists of a cash prize, a citation, and a shawl.

• Established in 1952, the Sangeet Natak Akademi has been instrumental in preserving and promoting the diverse cultural heritage of India.

• **Other Awardees (2021):**

• **Kalamandalam Girija:** Noted for her contributions to Mohiniyattam, a classical dance form from Kerala.

• **Bhuvan Kumar:** Recognized for his work in the field of Hindustani Vocal Music.

• **Bijay Kumar Jena:** Honored for his proficiency in Odissi dance.
